parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: The number of ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances to create. This parameter is applicable only to batch creation of ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances.

parameters.name: AutoCreateProxy
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically create a database proxy. Valid values:

parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
- **false**: Only an order is generated, and no payment is made.


> Default value: true. If your payment method has an insufficient balance, set AutoPay to false. An unpaid order is then generated. You can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment.
>

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. This parameter takes effect only when you create a subscription instance. Valid values:
- **true**
- **false**

> - If you purchase the instance on a monthly basis, the auto-renewal cycle is one month.
> - If you purchase the instance on a yearly basis, the auto-renewal cycle is one year.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use coupons. Valid values:
* **true**: Uses coupons.
* **false** (default): Does not use coupons.

> After coupons are used, if you perform a specification downgrade, the amount offset by coupons will not be refunded.

parameters.name: BabelfishConfig
parameters.description: The Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL configuration information.

parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the I/O burst feature for the premium performance disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: BusinessInfo
parameters.description: The business extension parameter.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The instance edition. Valid values:

* Regular instances
    * **Basic**: Basic Edition.
    * **HighAvailability**: High-availability Edition.
    * **cluster**: MySQL or PostgreSQL Cluster Edition.
    * **AlwaysOn**: SQL Server Cluster Edition.
    * **Finance**: RDS Enterprise Edition.
    > This parameter is required when you create an SQL Server Enterprise Cluster Edition instance<props="china">, a Basic Edition Standard instance</props>, or a Basic Edition Enterprise instance. For example, when you create a Basic Edition 2022 Enterprise Cluster Edition (2022_ent) instance, you must set this parameter to Basic.
* Serverless instances
    * **serverless_basic**: Serverless Basic Edition. (Applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
    * **serverless_standard**: Serverless High-availability Edition. (Applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
    * **serverless_ha**: SQL Server Serverless High-availability Edition.

    > This parameter is required when PayType is set to Serverless.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: ColdDataEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [cold data archiving](~~2701832~~) feature for Premium ESSDs. Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: ConnectionMode
parameters.description: The access mode of the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.description: The internal endpoint of the database.

parameters.name: CreateStrategy
parameters.description:
The strategy for batch instance creation. This parameter takes effect only when the value of **Amount** is greater than 1. Valid values:
* **Atomicity** (default): atomic. All instances in the same batch are either created successfully or fail together. If one instance fails to be created, all instances fail.
* **Partial**: non-atomic. The creation of an instance is not affected by other instances in the same batch.

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. You can specify a standard or YiTian instance type. For more information, see [Primary instance types](~~26312~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceDescription
parameters.description:
The instance name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, Chinese characters, letters, and hyphens (-).
>The name cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: DBInstanceNetType
parameters.description: The network connectivity type of the instance. Set the value to **Intranet**, which indicates an internal network connection.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage
parameters.description: The instance storage space. Unit: GB. The value increases in increments of 5 GB. For the value range, see [Instance types](~~26312~~).

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:
* **local_ssd**: Premium Local SSD (recommended).
* **general_essd**: Premium ESSD (recommended).
* **cloud_essd**: ESSD PL1.
* **cloud_essd2**: ESSD PL2.
* **cloud_essd3**: ESSD PL3.
* **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD (not recommended because this storage type is no longer available for purchase in some regions).

The default value of this parameter is automatically determined based on the instance type specified by the **DBInstanceClass** parameter:
* If the instance type is a Premium Local SSD instance type, the default value is **local_ssd**.
* If the instance type is a cloud disk instance type, the default value is **cloud_essd**.

> Serverless instances support only ESSD PL1 and Premium ESSD.

parameters.name: DBIsIgnoreCase
parameters.description:
Specifies whether table names are case-insensitive. Valid values:
* **true**: Case-insensitive. This is the default value.
* **false**: Case-sensitive.

parameters.name: DBParamGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parameter template. You can call DescribeParameterGroups to query parameter templates.
> Only MySQL and PostgreSQL support this parameter. If you do not specify this parameter, the system default parameter template is used. You can also create a custom parameter template and specify it here.

parameters.name: DBTimeZone
parameters.description:
The time zone of the instance. This parameter takes effect only when **Engine** is set to **MySQL** or **PostgreSQL**.

- If **Engine** is set to **MySQL**:
    - This parameter specifies a UTC time zone. Valid values: **-12:59** to **+13:00**.
    - Instances with Premium Local SSDs can use named time zones, such as Asia/Hong_Kong. For more information about named time zones, see [Named time zone reference](~~297356~~).
- If **Engine** is set to **PostgreSQL**:
    - This parameter specifies a named time zone. UTC time zones are not supported. For more information about named time zones, see [Named time zone reference](~~297356~~).
    - This parameter can be configured only for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks.

> - You can set the time zone when you purchase a primary instance. Read-only instances do not support time zone settings and inherit the time zone of the primary instance.
> - If you do not configure this parameter, the system selects the default time zone based on the region in which you purchase the instance.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId
parameters.description: The dedicated cluster host group ID.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature for the ApsaraDB RDS instance. This feature is supported only for pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:
* **true**: Enabled.
* **false**: Disabled (default).

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:

parameters.name: EncryptionKey
parameters.description: The ID of the encryption key that is used for cloud disk encryption in the same region. If you specify this parameter, cloud disk encryption is enabled and cannot be disabled. You must also specify **RoleARN**.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description:
The database engine. Valid values:
* **MySQL**
* **SQLServer**
* **PostgreSQL**
* **MariaDB**

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description:
The database engine version. Valid values:

* Regular instances
    * MySQL: **5.5**, **5.6**, **5.7**, **8.0**
    * SQL Server: **08r2_ent_ha** (cloud disk, discontinued), **2008r2** (Premium Local SSDs, discontinued), **2012** (Enterprise Edition Basic), **2012_ent_ha**, **2012_std_ha**, **2012_web**, **2014_ent_ha**, **2014_std_ha**, **2016_ent_ha**, **2016_std_ha**, **2016_web**, **2017_ent**, **2017_std_ha**, **2017_web**, **2019_ent**, **2019_std_ha**, **2019_web**, **2022_ent**, **2022_std_ha**, **2022_web**, **2025_ent**, **2025_std**
    * PostgreSQL: **10.0**, **11.0**, **12.0**, **13.0**, **14.0**, **15.0**, **16.0**, **17.0**, **18.0**
    * MariaDB: **10.3**, **10.6**
* Serverless instances
    * MySQL: **5.7**, **8.0**
    * SQL Server: **2016\_std\_sl**, **2017\_std\_sl**, **2019\_std\_sl**
    * PostgreSQL: **14.0**, **15.0**, **16.0**, **17.0**, **18.0**

> - MariaDB does not support serverless instances.
> - In SQL Server instance versions, `_ent` indicates Enterprise Cluster Edition, `_ent_ha` indicates Enterprise Edition, `_std_ha` indicates Standard Edition, and `_web` indicates Web Edition.
> - SQL Server 2014 instances are not available on the China site (Chinese mainland).
> - Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL instances support only major version 15.0.

parameters.name: ExternalReplication
parameters.description:
Enables or disables [native replication for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL](~~2856526~~). Valid values:
- **ON**: Enabled.
- **OFF**: Disabled.

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

* **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC).
* **Classic**: classic network.

> * ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with cloud disks support only VPC. Set this parameter to **VPC**.
> * ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL and MariaDB instances support only VPC. Set this parameter to **VPC**.
> * ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server Basic Edition and Web Edition instances support both the classic network and VPC. Other instances support only VPC. Set this parameter to **VPC**.

parameters.name: IoAccelerationEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE)](~~2527067~~) feature for Premium ESSDs. Valid values:

- **1**: Enabled.
- **0**: Not enabled.

parameters.name: OptimizedWrites
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [16KB atomic write](~~2858761~~) feature. Valid values:

- **optimized**: enabled.
- **none** (default): disabled.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Serverless**: serverless billing method. This value is not supported for MariaDB instances. For more information, see [Introduction to MySQL Serverless instances](~~411291~~), [Introduction to SQL Server Serverless instances](~~604344~~), and [Introduction to PostgreSQL Serverless instances](~~607742~~).
>The system automatically generates and completes the payment for the order. You do not need to manually confirm the payment.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the subscription instance uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle. Valid values:

* **Year**: yearly subscription.
* **Month**: monthly subscription.

> This parameter is required if the billing type is **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description:
Specifies the port number to initialize when the RDS instance is created. Valid values:
- MySQL: 1000 to 65534
- PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and MariaDB: 1000 to 5999

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: The internal IP address of the instance. The IP address must be within the IP address range of the specified vSwitch. The system automatically assigns an internal IP address based on the values of **VPCId** and **vSwitchId** by default.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~610399~~) to query available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: RoleARN
parameters.description: The global resource descriptor (ARN) that is used for the authorization of the primary account to allow the RDS service account to access Key Management Service (KMS). You can call the CheckCloudResourceAuthorized operation to query the ARN.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The [IP address whitelist](~~43185~~) of the instance. Separate multiple entries with commas (,). Entries cannot be duplicated. You can add up to 1,000 IP addresses or CIDR blocks per instance. The following two formats are supported:

parameters.name: ServerlessConfig
parameters.description:
The settings of the serverless ApsaraDB RDS instance. This parameter is required when you create a serverless instance.
>MariaDB does not support the creation of serverless instances.

parameters.name: StorageAutoScale
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic storage expansion. This parameter is supported only for MySQL and PostgreSQL. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageThreshold
parameters.description: The threshold (in percentage) that triggers automatic storage expansion. Valid values:

parameters.name: StorageUpperBound
parameters.description:
The maximum total storage capacity for automatic storage expansion. Automatic expansion does not cause the total storage capacity of the instance to exceed this value. Unit: GB.

> - The value must be greater than or equal to 0.
> - This parameter is required when **StorageAutoScale** is set to **Enable**.

parameters.name: SystemDBCharset
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. Specify this parameter to bind a tag to the instance.

* If the specified tag key already exists, the tag key is directly bound to the instance. Call ListTagResources to query existing tags.
* If the specified tag key does not exist, the tag key is created and then bound to the instance.
* Empty strings are not allowed.
* This parameter must be used together with the **Tag.Value** parameter. Neither parameter can be used alone.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value that corresponds to the tag key. Specify this parameter to bind a tag to the instance.

parameters.name: TargetDedicatedHostIdForLog
parameters.description: The host ID of the log instance in the dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: TargetDedicatedHostIdForMaster
parameters.description: The host ID of the primary instance in the dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: TargetDedicatedHostIdForSlave
parameters.description: The host ID of the secondary instance in the dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: TargetMinorVersion
parameters.description:
The minor engine version of the RDS instance to create. This parameter is required only when you create a MySQL or PostgreSQL instance.
Format:
* MySQL: `<instance version>_<numeric version number>`. Examples: `rds_20200229`, `xcluster_20200229`, or `xcluster80_20200229`. Description:
    * rds: High-availability Edition or Basic Edition.
    * xcluster: MySQL 5.7 RDS Enterprise Edition.
    * xcluster80: MySQL 8.0 RDS Enterprise Edition.

    > You can call the DescribeDBMiniEngineVersions operation to query the numeric version number. For more information about the differences between versions, see [AliSQL minor version release notes](~~96060~~).
* PostgreSQL: `rds_postgres_<major version>00_<minor version number>`. Example: `rds_postgres_1400_20220830`. Description:
    * 1400: The PostgreSQL major version is 14.
    * 20220830: The AliPG minor engine version. You can call the DescribeDBMiniEngineVersions operation to query this value. For more information about the differences between versions, see [PostgreSQL minor version release notes](~~126002~~).

    > If Babelfish is enabled in **BabelfishConfig**, the minor version format for the RDS PostgreSQL instance is: `rds_postgres_<major version>00_<AliPG minor engine version>_babelfish`.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The subscription duration. Valid values:

parameters.name: UserBackupId
parameters.description:
The user backup ID. You can call the ListUserBackupFiles operation to query user backup IDs. If you specify this parameter, an instance is created based on the user backup.

If you specify this parameter, the following limits apply:
- **PayType** must be set to **Postpaid**.
- **Engine** must be set to **MySQL**.
- **EngineVersion** must be set to **5.7**.
- **Category** must be set to **Basic**.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: WhitelistTemplateList
parameters.description: The whitelist template list.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID of the primary node.

- If you specify a VPC and a vSwitch, you must set this parameter to the zone ID of the specified vSwitch. Otherwise, the instance cannot be created.
- For high-availability series instances, you must also specify **ZoneIdSlave1** to determine whether the instance is deployed in a single zone or across multiple zones.
- For RDS Enterprise Edition instances, you must also specify **ZoneIdSlave1** and **ZoneIdSlave2** to determine whether the instance is deployed in a single zone or across multiple zones.
- For RDS Cluster Edition instances, you must also specify **ZoneIdSlave1** for two-node clusters, or **ZoneIdSlave1** and **ZoneIdSlave2** for three-node clusters.

parameters.name: ZoneIdSlave1
parameters.description:
The zone ID of the secondary node.

- If you set this parameter to **Auto**, the system uses multi-zone deployment and automatically selects a zone for the secondary node.
- If you set this parameter to the same value as **ZoneId**, single-zone deployment is used.
- If you set this parameter to a value different from **ZoneId**, multi-zone deployment is used.

parameters.name: ZoneIdSlave2
parameters.description: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL Cluster Edition instances support creating one or two secondary nodes when you create an instance. If you have this requirement, use this parameter to specify the zone of the second secondary node.
